name: Carving
overview: Scripture reveals that carving was a skilled art integral to both sacred and common objects, as seen in the detailed woodwork of the temple adorned with flowers, cherubim, and palm trees. Craftsmen like Bezaleel and Hiram were endowed to perform intricate carvings, including those on beds and stones, demonstrating the value of artistry in worship and daily life (Exodus 31:5; Proverbs 7:16). However, the Bible also sternly condemns carved idols and graven images as vain and unprofitable, calling for their destruction to maintain true devotion to God (Deuteronomy 7:5; Isaiah 44:9-10).
